title: hubHomePresentation
responsibility: Formats labels, activity totals, dates, subscription state and active work for home previews and dialogs.

inputs.name: count.value
inputs.description: Number used to select the singular or plural label.

inputs.name: count.singular
inputs.description: Label used when the count is one.

inputs.name: count.plural
inputs.description: Plural label. Defaults to the singular label followed by s.

inputs.name: homeHeadline.agents
inputs.description: Agents and their current Tracker context. A null value indicates loading where supported.

inputs.name: currentAgent.agents
inputs.description: Agents and their current Tracker context. A null value indicates loading where supported.

inputs.name: soonestWork.snapshot
inputs.description: The current published snapshot, if available for the operation.

inputs.name: workSummary.work
inputs.description: In-progress and blocked work items enriched with project labels and due dates.

inputs.name: warningFor.left
inputs.description: Remaining quota as a percentage from 0 to 100.

inputs.name: lowestLimit.subscriptions
inputs.description: Normalized provider subscription windows to compare.

inputs.name: staleReading.readAt
inputs.description: ISO timestamp of the last quota reading.

inputs.name: staleReading.now
inputs.description: Current time in milliseconds since the Unix epoch.

inputs.name: warningLabel.limit
inputs.description: Provider allowance window to label.

inputs.name: runDay.at
inputs.description: ISO timestamp of a scheduled run.

inputs.name: runDay.now
inputs.description: Current time in milliseconds since the Unix epoch.

inputs.name: runTime.at
inputs.description: ISO timestamp of a scheduled run.

inputs.name: when.time
inputs.description: ISO timestamp for the presentation label, or null when the reset time is unavailable.

inputs.name: quotaReset.time
inputs.description: ISO timestamp for the presentation label, or null when the reset time is unavailable.

inputs.name: quotaReset.now
inputs.description: Current time in milliseconds since the Unix epoch.

inputs.name: initials.name
inputs.description: Display name from which initials are derived.

inputs.name: overviewTone.state
inputs.description: Agent activity state used to choose a presentation tone.

inputs.name: summaryLine.work
inputs.description: In-progress and blocked work items enriched with project labels and due dates.

inputs.name: summaryLine.scheduled
inputs.description: Number of upcoming scheduled runs.

inputs.name: relativeWhen.time
inputs.description: ISO timestamp for the presentation label, or null when the reset time is unavailable.

inputs.name: relativeWhen.now
inputs.description: Current time in milliseconds since the Unix epoch.

inputs.name: workEta.due
inputs.description: Due date as an ISO timestamp, or null if the work has no due date.

inputs.name: workEta.now
inputs.description: Current time in milliseconds since the Unix epoch.

outputs.name: sections
outputs.description: Display titles and count nouns keyed by home section.

outputs.name: agentLabels
outputs.description: Display labels keyed by agent state.

outputs.name: agentGroups
outputs.description: Agent states in the order shown in the dialog.

outputs.name: planLabels
outputs.description: Display labels keyed by plan state.

outputs.name: planStates
outputs.description: Plan states in the order shown in the dialog.

outputs.name: providerNames
outputs.description: Display names of supported subscription providers.

outputs.name: usageLinks
outputs.description: Account usage links keyed by provider.

outputs.name: count
outputs.description: Count and an appropriately inflected label.

outputs.name: homeHeadline
outputs.description: Dashboard headline summarizing working agents and outstanding questions.

outputs.name: currentAgent
outputs.description: Eligible agent who needs a response, otherwise the first eligible agent or undefined.

outputs.name: soonestWork
outputs.description: Active tasks sorted by deadline, with undated work last and titles breaking ties.

outputs.name: workSummary
outputs.description: Number of active tasks and unique projects.

outputs.name: warningFor
outputs.description: Critical below 10 percent, low below 25 percent, otherwise null.

outputs.name: lowestLimit
outputs.description: Subscription window with the lowest remaining percentage among warnings, if any.

outputs.name: staleReading
outputs.description: Whether the last subscription reading is over one hour old.

outputs.name: warningLabel
outputs.description: Short label for the severity of a quota warning.

outputs.name: runDay
outputs.description: Today, Tomorrow or the calendar date in Lisbon.

outputs.name: runTime
outputs.description: Scheduled time in Lisbon in 24-hour notation.

outputs.name: when
outputs.description: Local short calendar date.

outputs.name: quotaReset
outputs.description: Rounded countdown or current availability of the reset time.

outputs.name: initials
outputs.description: Up to two uppercase initials from the display name.

outputs.name: overviewTone
outputs.description: Visual tone for the agent activity state.

outputs.name: summaryLine
outputs.description: Short headline summary of active tasks, projects and scheduled runs.

outputs.name: relativeWhen
outputs.description: Relative age for recent records or their calendar date.

outputs.name: workEta
outputs.description: Deadline label and its urgency tone.
